Kernels popped in a heavy covered pot in coconut oil, shaken constantly, tipped out and tossed with melted butter and fine salt.
Corn chips with a fresh salsa of diced tomato, red onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime, salted and left 10 minutes to get juicy.
Randy's shift at the video store

Dark and milk chocolate rocky road loaded with marshmallows, raspberry lollies, roasted peanuts and crushed pretzels for a salty crunch. Melt 250g milk chocolate and 150g dark chocolate together over simmering water. Stir in 100g marshmallows, 100g raspberry lollies, 100g roasted peanuts and 60g crushed pretzels. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, sprinkle with flaky salt and chill 2 hours until set. Cut into 16 chunky squares with a hot knife.
M: the horror movie rules at the party

Crisp thin-crust pizza loaded with pepperoni and mushrooms, hot honey drizzled over the top, sliced and left in the box for the crowd. Heat a pizza steel or stone at the highest oven setting for 45 minutes. Stretch 2 x 250g balls pizza dough into thin rounds. Spread each with 100g crushed tomato seasoned with garlic and oregano. Top with 125g mozzarella, 60g pepperoni and 80g sliced mushrooms. Bake each for 7 minutes until blistered. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over. Slice and serve in the boxes.
the party at Stu's house on the night it all goes wrong
Big tray of pasta layered with slow beef ragu and ricotta, topped with mozzarella and baked until bubbling.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into long ovals, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with royal icing, the face piped on in black.
K: the house party at Stu's place

A big red punch of vodka, cranberry, pineapple and lime topped with lemonade, loaded with ice and orange slices, served in plastic party cups. In a big punch bowl, stir together 200ml vodka, 500ml cranberry juice, 500ml pineapple juice and the juice of 3 limes. Chill for 1 hour. Just before serving, add 750ml cold lemonade, a bag of ice and 1 sliced orange. Ladle into 4 plastic party cups. Swap the vodka for extra lemonade for anyone driving.

s.note: Casey shaking the pan while the phone rings
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels in a heavy covered pot. When they pop, add 120g kernels and shake constantly until the popping slows. Tip out and toss with 50g melted butter and fine salt.
Dice 4 tomatoes, half a red onion and a jalapeño. Mix with chopped coriander, the juice of a lime and salt, and leave 10 minutes to get juicy. Serve with a 300g bag of corn chips.

m.note: the party at Stu's house on the night it all goes wrong
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 700g tomato passata and simmer for 20 minutes. Layer in a dish with 250g lasagne sheets, 500g ricotta mixed with 1 egg, and the sauce, finishing with 200g grated mozzarella. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut into long ovals and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice white with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, then pipe the face in black icing.
